conservation.condition_narrative: "Worcester Art Museum, Worcester. Sprayed with acrylic resin . . . copolimer n-butyl and . . . methacrylate 10% solution . . . mixture xylene 50% and . . . #1 50%. Sept 1960 by E. de Beaumont, Conservator" (typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

conservation.condition_narrative: Overall good condition. Areas of fine cracks as noted. Felt liner fuzz visible around painting edges. Few accretions caught in felt. Fiber caught in varnish in ML quad. Few scattered tiny white dots.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Cantor Center in 2025.
